abstract: A case of stage IIB seminomatous tumor treated with the combination chemotherapy regimen of cis-platinum, vinblastin and bleomycin is presented. The patient was a 42-year-old man who was admitted to our hospital with the chief complaint of the right intrascrotal mass and edema in right lower extremity. Right radical orchiectomy was immediately performed under the diagnosis of testicular tumor. Histological diagnosis was pure seminoma. Paraaortic bulky metastasis and right hydronephrosis were found in the abdominal CT-scan. PVB therapy for initial treatment was started. After four courses of this therapy, retroperitoneal lymphadenectomy was performed. Because no live tumor cells were found histologically in any of the dissected material, complete response was considered to have been achieved by PVB therapy. Considering the poor survival and high relapse rate of advanced seminomatous tumor treated with radiotherapy, this PVB therapy should be the initial treatment for this disease.
abstract_ja: 病期IIBのセミノーマ性胚細胞腫瘍の1例を報告する。症例は42歳の男性で、右陰嚢内腫瘤と右下肢浮腫を主訴に当院を受診した。精巣腫瘍の診断で直ちに右根治的精巣摘除術を施行した。組織学的診断は純粋セミノーマであった。腹部コンピュータ断層撮影(CT)で傍大動脈の巨大転移と右水腎症が認められた。初回治療としてPVB療法を開始した。4コース施行後、後腹膜リンパ節郭清を行った。切除された全検体において組織学的に生存腫瘍細胞は認められず、PVB療法により完全奏効が得られたと考えられた。放射線療法で治療された進行セミノーマは予後不良で再発率も高いことを考慮すると、この疾患の初回治療としてPVB療法を行うべきである。
